for lease in leases:
            net = ipaddress.IPv6Network(lease['prefix'], strict=True)
            base = int(net.network_address)
            table = {}
            lows = set()
            for subnet in sorted(lease['subnets']):
                n64 = base + (subnet << 64)
                canonical = str(ipaddress.IPv6Network((n64, 64)))
                digest = hashlib.sha256('\n'.join([seed, lease['id'], canonical]).encode()).digest()
                canary = int.from_bytes(digest[:8], 'big') | (1 << 63)
                table['%d/c' % subnet] = (n64 + canary, True)
                for i in range(1, lease['low_count'] + 1):
                    table['%d/i%d' % (subnet, i)] = (n64 + i, False)
                    lows.add(n64 + i)
            self.probes[lease['id']] = table
            self.lows[lease['id']] = lows
        self.evidence = {}      # lease -> {'internal': set, 'external': set}
        self.make_rows()
        captures = self.captures()
        job = {'version': 3, 'seed': seed, 'leases': leases, 'services': services,
               'queries': queries, 'captures': captures, 'requests': [], 'offers': [],
               'request_quotas': [], 'offer_quotas': []}
        import reference as R
        rows, rejected, error = R.decode_captures(job, self.probes)
        snapshots = R.census(job, rows or [], self.probes, self.lows)
        # triples that are guaranteed to be active when turned into requests
        eligible = []
        for snap in snapshots:
            for lease in snap['leases']:
                if lease['state'] != 'usable':
                    continue
